name: sceneview
description: Build 3D and AR with SceneView for Android (Jetpack Compose, Filament, ARCore), web and Compose Multiplatform desktop. Includes retained references for end-of-life SwiftUI, Flutter and React Native 4.68.0.

interface.shortDescription: Write 3D and AR code for Android, web and Compose Multiplatform desktop
interface.longDescription: SceneView is an AI-first 3D and AR SDK maintained for Android (Jetpack Compose, Filament, ARCore), web (Filament.js, WebXR) and Compose Multiplatform desktop. This plugin provides API references, recipes, migration guides and the sceneview-mcp tools. SwiftUI (iOS, macOS, visionOS), Flutter and React Native are end of life: 4.68.0 (November 2026) is the last release. No new releases. Their documentation is retained for existing users. See https://github.com/sceneview/sceneview/blob/main/DEPRECATION.md. SceneView is open source under Apache-2.0.
defaultPrompt: Build a Jetpack Compose screen that loads a .glb model with SceneView, orbit camera and a light.
Add ARCore plane detection with SceneView and place the model where the user taps.
Maintain or migrate this existing SceneViewSwift 4.68.0 app; the package is end of life.
Render a GLB in the browser with sceneview-web and add a WebXR 'View in AR' button.
Migrate this SceneView 2.x snippet to the 4.x composable API.
Show me this 3D model URL inline and tell me how to load it in Compose.
Open the .3mf file a print flow gave me in a Compose viewer, then place it in AR at its real size.
